column1: # Words the user asked for by name. The corpus does not decide them. build_pack.py reads four
# columns with a tab between them: the word in lower case, its preferred form or nothing, its
# frequency on the Zipf scale or nothing for REQUESTED_ZIPF, and the source.
# A word has a frequency of its own when the keyboard changes the word in a clean dev case at
# REQUESTED_ZIPF. The word then takes the lowest frequency of the grid of requested_frequency.py
# --word WORD at which each of its clean dev cases is right: 5.5 for "xcode" and "vite". The
# existing dev cases come first: "todo" has the highest frequency of that grid at which the
# keyboard still reads a typed "todo" as "to do" in the two existing dev cases that mean it.
